items.q: [MR. WILSON, JR.] But they make a point of people knowing about the funeral bands in New Orleans and the early days of Joe King Oliver and all those things that led to Chicago.

ctx.x: Well, yeah. See, out here, they got their own little radio stations, these schools out here have their own stations where they play jazz and blues and their version of pop and folk. The student programs run the radio stations.

But they make a point of people knowing about the funeral bands in New Orleans and the early days of Joe King Oliver and all those things that led to Chicago. They don't just say, well, that existed, and then jump right to the ..
New York is so spread around, though, with the ethnic groups.
